itineraries.title: Five days from Ischia
itineraries.intro: Ischia and Procida, then Capri across the gulf.

days.note: The thermal gardens at Poseidon and a quiet evening at Sant’Angelo.
The pastel harbour of Corricella, then a swim at Chiaiolella.
The Faraglioni at first light, then lunch on board at Marina Piccola.
A swim off Li Galli before the day boats, then a long lunch at Marina del Cantone.
The thermal gardens at Poseidon and a quiet evening at Sant’Angelo.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Naples to Amalfi
itineraries.intro: The classic week: the Gulf of Naples, Ischia and Procida, then Capri and the Amalfi Coast at an unhurried pace.

days.note: Board in Naples; a first evening at anchor off Posillipo.
Thermal gardens and the Aragonese castle; a quiet evening at Sant’Angelo.
The pastel harbour of Corricella, then a swim at Chiaiolella.
The Faraglioni at first light; lunch on board at Marina Piccola.
Li Galli in the morning, a long lunch at Marina del Cantone.
The boutiques ashore; dinner on deck off the bay.
The cathedral steps and Ravello; disembark in Amalfi or return to Naples.
